claim: For the 256 geometric nodes of the magic-square surface \(V\) in Auel–Singer, arXiv:2609.09351v1, the action of \(\mathrm{Gal}(\mathbb Q(\sqrt2,i)/\mathbb Q)\cong C_2\times C_2\) has exactly \(112\) orbits: \(96\) of size \(2\) and \(16\) of size \(4\). More precisely, the \(128\)-point automorphism orbit of \(p_1\) splits into \(64\) pairs defined over \(\mathbb Q(\sqrt2)\), the \(64\)-point orbit of \(p_3\) into \(32\) pairs defined over \(\mathbb Q(i)\), and the \(64\)-point orbit of \(p_2\) into \(16\) quartets defined over \(\mathbb Q(\sqrt2,i)\); in particular, no node is rational over \(\mathbb Q\).

integrity.computational_claims: finite group counts shown in the proof; no exhaustive external certification claimed
integrity.proof_basis: explicit representatives, geometric-automorphism orbit sizes, and coordinatewise Galois action

scientific_limitations: The result classifies Galois orbits and fields of definition of the 256 nodes only; it does not determine the full Galois representation on the Picard group or a Brauer–Manin obstruction.
The independent audit has not been performed.
title: Galois fields of definition of the 256 nodes on the magic-square surface
